using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class MigrationDriverTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TestLogError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrationDriver = new MigrationDriver(loggerMock.Object);

            // Act
            await migrationDriver.BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogError(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}
